title: Platform Engineer
question:
The form is filled in Chrome and recorded in Notion. Before you submit, check these:

- **Hybrid in four cities; each needs a visa.** Three days a week in the San Francisco, New York, Seattle or London office, outside your usual cities.
- **No Kubernetes operator experience.** The cover letter says so openly.
- **The form has no salary question.**

**Audit file:** Location and CV fields checked on the page; the audit helper showed both as empty. I corrected those in the file and removed a duplicate, empty "Resume/CV" row. The run log has a note about both audit gaps.

Review it and submit it yourself when you're happy.
location: San Francisco; New York; Seattle; London
